card.name: Of/the inside Tale titles
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'of' or 'the' inside a title such as 'Tale of Genji' or 'Tale of the Heike', and 'of' after 'Tales' or a saint's name. It also fires weakly on the last word of feedback or contact requests.

modes.label: Titles with Tale(s) of
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'the' right after 'Tale' or 'Tales' in a literary work title.
modes.example: Tale<< of>> Genji, Outlaws of the Marsh

modes.label: Of after a saint's name
modes.description: The word 'of' linking a name to a place in a historical or religious title.
modes.example: Apocryphal Acts of Saint Ignatius<< of>> Antioch

modes.label: Contact and feedback requests
modes.description: A noun ending a request to send comments or report problems on a web page.
modes.example: E-mail me with questions,<< comments>>, or solutions

card.plain: It marks the little word 'of' or 'the' inside the title of a story, such as Tale of Genji.
